title: Sunscreen SPF50

drivers.name: TikTok trend
drivers.evidence: No past TikTok-driven sales spikes found; only one novel driver. Noise-adjusted effect shrunk to x1.015. Not enough evidence for larger effect.

adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 25.3. No events or promotions in target week. Price increased 4.1% to $13.93, which typically suppresses demand; past price hikes show no lift. However, product is trending on TikTok, a novel driver with no historical precedent. Recent weeks show declining trend (21.9% drop in 13-week mean), but baseline already captures this. No past TikTok-driven surge found. The classical uplift model gives 1.00, but judgment calls for a small upside from unmeasured virality. Evidence is thin—no past data—so shrink toward 1.0. Confidence is low.

'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
